methods.label: Find and double the unknown half-diagonal
methods.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other at right angles. Half of one diagonal is 12, and half of the other is \(\sqrt{13^2-12^2}=5\), so the other diagonal has length 10.
methods.levelReason: The method uses Grade 8 rhombus properties and the Pythagorean theorem.
